title: Messaging and Fold Activity
notes: Long-press conversations to select and delete multiple synchronized conversation histories at once.
Fixes Fold likes and encrypted comments, including honest comment error handling that preserves unsent drafts.
Supports tagging canonical handles that contain spaces, including quoted mentions when needed.
Fold post, comment, reaction, invitation, and join notifications now open the relevant Fold activity.
Nexus Notify now updates automatically alongside Connect and restarts its notification relay after replacement.
